title: NPU: two layers in a row
task: For the laboratory profile (the NPU at 0x5000_0000; register map in the Help). Two 4 × 4 INT8 matrices W1 and W2 are at w1 and w2 (one word per row, W[i][j] in bits 8j+7 to 8j) and a vector x at x (one INT8 value per word). Using the NPU for both products, compute h = W1 x and store it as four words at h, then compute y = W2 h and store it as four words at y; then halt. The tests choose values for which every h[i] fits in INT8.
starter:
# npu-two-layers -- practice exercise (MAVILERA)
# h = W1 x, then y = W2 h, both on the NPU.
# Hint: ACT[j] takes bits 7..0 of the word written, so a result that fits in INT8 can be written back as it is; load W2 only when the first run is done.
# Laboratory profile: the NPU at 0x5000_0000 (CTRL 0x00, STATUS 0x04, WEIGHT 0x10, ACT 0x20, RESULT 0x30).
        .equ NPU, 0x50000000
        .data
w1:     .word 0x00000001, 0x00000100, 0x00010000, 0x01000000
w2:     .word 0x01010101, 0x00000000, 0x00000000, 0x00000000
x:      .word 1, 2, 3, 4
h:      .space 16
y:      .space 16
        .text
main:   # your code
        halt
